reason: The only measured n=512 evidence is for the unchanged full-kernel build at about 1035–1071 GFLOP/s; there is no measured result for any proposed change, and the target remains unmet. The first six proposals describe the same 16-call panel32 wrapper, so they are one experiment, not distinct wins. I rank the directly scoped fast-path experiment first; the duplicates follow, with no causal or advisor-specific claim. The B-panel idea adds a full-matrix allocation and copy, and its layout compatibility is unverified. The tail change affects only fallback sizes, not the n=512 hill workload, so it ranks last.
